numbering.rule: Newly found existing-scope behavior and defects reopen their existing owner/checklist. Add or renumber stages only for an explicitly reviewed scope change; no unbounded M5.21 tail.

resolution.inventory: All 775 AST records retain exact source/ledger pointers, including duplicate symbols.
resolution.inheritance: Every entry requires the union of required_steps for ALL its profiles. primary_owner routes bookkeeping only, never drops secondary owners. Ledger entry defaults/local overrides and original acceptance remain in force.
resolution.supplemental: The 750 UI records are 16 nested helpers +96 declaration surfaces +484 fields +53 call signatures +101 configuration paths. These call signatures are separate from the 53 dynamic groups.
resolution.semantic: Ownership completeness is not behavior or exhaustive runtime closure. P0.1 must enumerate inherited/external/branch/callback paths and assign discoveries to these owners.
resolution.gate: Before each implementation: representative HTML/TS contract, actual helper/caller reachability, mutation/failure/lifetime rules, tests/docs/exit checklist and review. Only new core contracts or scope/lost-capability decisions require renewed review.
resolution.evidence: Reuse verified selected implementations and preserve historical identities; new final behavior needs current evidence. No original ledger or runtime is changed by this plan.

stages.title: Complete the semantic inventory
stages.scope: Resolve every structural, dynamic, helper, external declaration/configuration and inherited transport record against shipped code, defaults, branches, callbacks and actual callers. Include non-JSON/inherited values, aliases and externally invoked inspection. Record newly found paths under their existing owner.
stages.acceptance: All known records have a primary owner and every secondary family owner; each remaining behavior has a concrete acceptance case or a documented decision candidate. Declaration syntax/TODOs alone do not prove shipped behavior.

stages.title: One omission decision and helper boundary
stages.scope: Prepare one complete lost-workflow proposal covering core R01-R08, Grid GR01-GR03 and any additional proven losses found in P0.1. Separate unrelated helper U01 from UI family U01. Classify direct, transitive, config, declaration, alias and external reachability.
stages.acceptance: The user decides actual omissions once; rejected or undecided candidates remain required in their numbered owners. Unused/unrelated helper removal uses existing authorization only after proof. Record lost workflow, replacement, affected callers and migration cost.
stages.condition: User decision is required only for genuine capability omissions; independent work may continue while it is pending.

stages.title: Replace live Form-owned choice catalogs
stages.scope: Extend the M5.13 specific group/Form owners for safe adopted replacement; retain source, drafts, creation captures and native defaults, compiled members, reset ownership, labels, errors, focus and claims.
stages.acceptance: Zero/one/many choices, unavailable stored/draft codes, same-code replacement, disabled choices, reentry, cancellation, insertion failure, rescan and disposal leave coherent data and usable ownership. No second binding engine.

stages.title: Ordered communication and finalization
stages.scope: Complete request prepare/init/send/success/error/completion order, transformations, stop/recovery effects, captured or deliberate live policy, timeout and abort ownership.
stages.acceptance: Arguments, receiver migration, thrown/rejected hooks and cancellation have explicit outcomes; completion settles exactly once. Existing replacement-Request cancellation remains.

stages.title: Remaining protocol and inherited transport workflows
stages.scope: Crosswalk concrete inherited AjaxSettings workflows: headers/auth/credentials, HTTP/body/query/cache/CORS/base URL/URL guards, FormData, text/HTML/empty/custom decoding, status and timeout behavior. Retain accepted q=JSON/rowStatus recipes.
stages.acceptance: Every inherited option has a tested equivalent, a proven non-shipped status or the single approved omission disposition, including synchronous/script/JSONP candidates. Business wire conversion stays application-owned.
stages.condition: Unsupported actual transport workflows depend on the P0.2 decision; no pending candidate is silently removed.

stages.title: One HTML loader and host ownership
stages.scope: Connect remote views to the common communication policy in content, Popup, Tabs and Documents. Resolve destination/additive/replacement/reload modes and inert HTML plus explicit controller loading.
stages.acceptance: Auth/transforms/errors/completion/cancel apply to views; old content and new partial failures clean up correctly; independent instances and unique IDs remain. Resolve embedded-script/discovery workflow R01 explicitly.
stages.condition: R01 remains required until implemented equivalently or approved in P0.2.

stages.title: CVC metadata and lifecycle
stages.scope: Finish caller/opener/parent/request/input/output/context metadata and ready/init/activate/deactivate/open/reload/dispose order across all containers.
stages.acceptance: Concurrent instances, rapid reload, initialization failure, delayed response and parent closure preserve identity and release resources; no mutable global controller discovery is assumed.

stages.title: Scoped application configuration and services
stages.scope: Define creation snapshots versus explicit live defaults/locale/messages/rules/service-handle updates. Reuse existing typed presets and forwarding closures; resolve legacy registry/context workflows.
stages.acceptance: Two pages and two application scopes remain independent; updating intended live policy reaches existing consumers and does not change captured policy accidentally. R04 losses are explicit.
stages.condition: Global-discovery/default losses follow P0.2; an ordinary typed application object is the starting design.

stages.title: Controller advice and useful interception
stages.scope: Complete explicit before/after/around/error composition and the useful workflows behind legacy path/view/custom pointcuts.
stages.acceptance: Argument/result/proceed order, veto, sync throws, promise rejection and startup cancellation work without copying synchronous-only legacy defects. Resolve R02.
stages.condition: Automatic interception remains required unless the single decision approves a proven loss.

stages.title: Typed asynchronous declarations and actions
stages.scope: Assemble explicit component, communication and event declarations separately from handles; load/filter code data and choose defaults before dependent initialization. Connect search/Enter, delayed open and stable row actions.
stages.acceptance: Failures/abort stop later construction/actions; binding precedes events; declaration types never change into handle types. List and grouped/custom targets retain RowId and owned cleanup. Resolve R03 string interpretation.

stages.title: Inspection and event/filter introspection
stages.scope: Resolve application-wired runtime HTML inspection, custom rules/findings/exclusions/severity/abort/sourceURL, handler enumeration/priority, expression filters and scoped context lookup.
stages.acceptance: Every shipped custom workflow is retained through a tested scoped alternative or explicitly approved in P0.2. Build-time lint/source maps are not assumed equivalent; optional external invocation is not unused.
stages.condition: R05/R06 and related helper mechanisms retain their exact decision outcomes.

stages.title: Data values, schemas and projections
stages.scope: Finish JSON/nested/own/inherited/mutable/non-JSON boundaries, configured extra keys, selected/checked/changed projections and shared consumer semantics using Rows. Retain incoming checkpoints, ordered operations and wire recipes.
stages.acceptance: Actual legacy cases resolve to preserved behavior, explicit application conversion or a genuine approved loss; business keys survive and RowId stays local. No second synchronization store or generic data library.

stages.title: Remaining Form create/default/update workflows
stages.scope: Complete entered/default creation, indexed/addTop composition, auto-unbind/state/cache/update/remove/revert semantics and failure restoration.
stages.acceptance: Native reset, captured DOM/defaults, parsed creation values and received originals keep distinct owners; notifications and drafts survive the documented creation/update/removal branches. Reuse existing defaults/unbind/rescan.

stages.title: Exact Form/source callback and receiver outcomes
stages.scope: Resolve per-unbound/inherited-key iteration, equal-write callbacks, before-set old values, post-notification mutation, local/global ordering, false/return effects, initial selection and receiver migration.
stages.acceptance: Each discrepancy has an executed intended-workflow case or a concrete P0.2 disposition. Whole hooks/source subscriptions do not substitute for different per-key timing. Capture/live/plain-call policy is uniform and explicit.

stages.title: Retained rules and live configuration
stages.scope: Close all 23 formatter and 41 validator names/aliases, arguments, raw/display/unformat, blank/required/equalTo, separators/bytes/mask/date/time, messages and existing-instance policy updates. Resolve standalone/manual rule workflows.
stages.acceptance: Indirect HTML/config/declaration users keep required behavior; argument/failure/user overrides and locale changes have witnesses. Retain only framework-used internal operations. R08 and mutable mask diagnostics receive explicit dispositions.

stages.title: Shared native and generated row-control contracts
stages.scope: Complete the remaining Form/Grid/List control, typed-choice, radio/checkbox-array, image/rich-render and nested binding crosswalk through actual shared private owners. Include generated groups in repeated/declarative row contexts where legacy callers use them.
stages.acceptance: Sort/filter/page/recompile and zero/one/many options keep raw identity, labels, native names, constraints, drafts and restoration. Editable List integration follows M6.2; no public DOM/path/format utility is added.

stages.title: Select and generated-choice mutation matrix
stages.scope: Finish index/value, append/remove/reindex, reset-first versus authored/default selection, missing/duplicate choices and native events across standalone/adopted/repeated contexts.
stages.acceptance: Mutation/default/event/callback capture and receiver cases are typed and consistent; source/drafts survive adopted changes. Reuse M5.14 and existing option maps rather than a second choice registry.

stages.title: Editable List
stages.scope: Implement actual List native/group editing, row Form/value/update actions, typed nested choices, parsers, cross-field rules, drafts and invalid reveal.
stages.acceptance: Editing the sorted/filtered/paged row commits to the correct RowId; rejected input stays recoverable, hidden drafts validate, shared Forms/Grid update and removed rows stop events.

stages.title: List active selection, multiple selection and checks
stages.scope: Complete row-click/toggle/unselect, hover, ranges/veto/disabled eligibility, separate checked IDs, scoped All/exclusive/mixed state and projections.
stages.acceptance: Pointer/keyboard/range/check operations retain stable identity through editing, filtering, paging, mutations and rebind; selection is distinct from checking.

stages.title: List creation, order and row resources
stages.scope: Connect defaults/addSelect, beforeRow/addTop, move/copy/remove/revert, clean append/update completion and arbitrary row actions to Rows and owned row hooks.
stages.acceptance: Copies are independent; insertion/selection policy and callback order are explicit; row cleanup runs once and no duplicate CRUD store appears.

stages.title: List progressive work and geometry
stages.scope: Complete delayed/cooperative binding, scrollPaging admission/index/size, append/add/select/check/validate reveal, height resize and scroll containment.
stages.acceptance: Admission/completion/cancel/retry, focus/drafts and owned resources remain bounded for declared fixtures. Paging is not called virtualization; mandatory Grid virtualization does not imply a new List viewport engine.

stages.title: Pagination windows and set navigation
stages.scope: Add configurable numeric windows, previous/next set jumps, navigation-info outcomes, bind/onChange suppression and localized accessible state.
stages.acceptance: Boundary/empty/shrinking totals, keyboard/focus, Grid/List synchronization and programmatic versus native callback behavior have witnesses.

stages.title: Native and anchor actions
stages.scope: Complete native-button and anchor enable/disable/input blocking, pointer/Enter/Space, accessible state, creation hooks and owned teardown.
stages.acceptance: Disabled actions cannot execute; author content/styles and focus semantics restore correctly; no mandatory design/theme or automatic wrapper is introduced.

stages.title: Authored Alert and confirm
stages.scope: Provide reusable authored message/confirm results, OK/cancel, localization/buttons, backdrop/Escape, veto and close/remove/error policies on existing dialog/CVC owners.
stages.acceptance: Exact result/callback ordering, nested focus restoration and failed/canceled/repeated use are tested; names alone do not count as capability parity.

stages.title: Contextual messages
stages.scope: Complete arbitrary element/input/window messages, arrays/substitutions, inert authored rich content, replacement/removal, optional accessible expiry and scoped blocking.
stages.acceptance: Announcements, focus, dismissal, timers, repeated replacement and disposal are correct; field validation errors are not the only supported context.

stages.title: Nonmodal and retained Dialog
stages.scope: Add nonmodal presentation, hide-retain/reopen and bounded title dragging with keyboard alternatives; reconcile positioning, scrolling, resize, save-memory/topmost outcomes.
stages.acceptance: Retained state, pointer/keyboard containment and nested focus remain usable across viewport changes; no z-index/pixel compatibility engine or resource accumulation.

stages.title: Popup preload and lifetime policies
stages.scope: Complete preloaded, retained and recreated Popup controllers, opener/input/output metadata and load/open/close/onOpenData/onCloseData ordering.
stages.acceptance: All policies use the common loader/runtime; failure, abort, reopen, result settlement, guarded close and repeated teardown preserve state and ownership.

stages.title: Tabs activation and overflow
stages.scope: Complete per-entry preload/stateless/active/disabled policy, activation input, initial callback suppression, live disabled-focus reconciliation and overflow/reveal.
stages.acceptance: Lazy/preloaded/recreated pages, rapid activation, abort/retry and keyboard/manual activation work in two independent authored layouts.

stages.title: Tree identity and selection
stages.scope: Finish display-key versus identity-value and level/parent/root mappings, folder/leaf policy, label/icon toggling, expand/collapse-all and callbacks.
stages.acceptance: Mutation, keyboard/typeahead, repeated IDs/labels and folder eligibility remain correct; old TODO-only methods are not invented as shipped capabilities.

stages.title: Tree checks
stages.scope: Add descendant cascade, mixed ancestors, checked leaf/all projections, event/change context and keyboard checking.
stages.acceptance: Insert/move/remove/reload and disabled branches reconcile check state and native/ARIA semantics without feedback loops or orphan resources.

stages.title: Attached and declarative day-date editors
stages.scope: Attach day-date editors to Form/Grid/editable List and typed declarations/rules; synchronize raw/display, bounds and focusin/show/hide/select phases. Define the shared month-attachment boundary; functional month attachment completes with M11.4.
stages.acceptance: Initial/dynamic/offscreen day fields attach once; real vetoes, ranges, rescan/rebind/disposal preserve labels/focus and stop late writes. A display-only date formatter is not attachment equivalence.

stages.title: Month, period and holiday controls
stages.scope: Finish YYYY-MM selection, direct year/month input/panels, year bounds, recurring/one-off named holidays, locale and touch/wheel with keyboard alternatives. Complete functional month-only attachment to Form/Grid/List and formatter/declaration composition through the M11.3 owner.
stages.acceptance: Period/bounds/leap/holiday cases, functional YYYY-MM attachment/raw/display/validation/veto and dynamic cleanup have witnesses; calendar calculations stay private and business-day libraries are not added.

stages.title: Authored notifications, actions and expiry
stages.scope: Extend current notifications with inert rich/actions, function/hash/URL workflows, placement/stacking/labels and opt-in expiry/pause/dismissal.
stages.acceptance: Announcements, action ownership, focus-safe timers, replacement/cancel and cleanup work; change existing template restrictions with the implemented contract.

stages.title: Documents SDI and metadata
stages.scope: Complete SDI replacement, duplicate-key update, caller/input/output/request/context metadata, entry/shell veto/lifecycle/stateless policies and verified URL/history recipes.
stages.acceptance: Common page loading and activation remain correct for multiple shells; trace external saveHistory consumers before classifying any absence as unused.

stages.title: Document capacity, state eviction and menus
stages.scope: Finish maxTabs/maxStateful, retained-entry page eviction/removeState hooks, insertion order/addLast, bulk-close/except-active/redirect, menus and overflow/reveal.
stages.acceptance: Eviction differs from closing; refusals/cancel/limits/reopen and keyboard/focus remain coherent without accumulating controllers or subscriptions.

stages.title: Scoped shell request progress
stages.scope: Aggregate concurrent/background requests with exclusions, counters/max/progress, error/complete/abort/reset, blocking and loaded-document context.
stages.acceptance: Each terminal request settles once; close/reload and two shells remain independent. Reuse communicator hooks and specific shell ownership, not global request filters.

stages.title: Final Data/Form and shared-control acceptance
stages.scope: Join actual Data/Form, editable List, Tree/date and Grid use cases against all remaining default/source/rule/receiver/native-control obligations.
stages.acceptance: Own/inherited/extra values, 0/1/N choices, two-store isolation, shared-store updates, restore/draft/cancel and complete payload cases resolve. Register evidence; do not rebuild selected M5.1-M5.13 behavior.

stages.title: Grid validation and unvalidated paste policy
stages.scope: Resolve unvalidated paste and legacy changed/already-invalid/off-page scope using current validation/paste owners and existing explicit-ID recipes.
stages.acceptance: A reviewed typed policy separates parser/native-integrity boundaries from rule validation; atomicity, drafts, protected controls, hidden rows and failure behavior remain explicit. Current always-validated paste is not silently changed.

stages.title: Grid integration with completed owners
stages.scope: Finish remaining typed template/components/events, generated row controls, defaults/messages/rules, receiver/initial-selection/discovery, Popup details and old customization outcomes through their actual owners.
stages.acceptance: Add only missing integration witnesses. Keep current columns/multiselection/paste/viewport/multi-tr/merge/progressive/pinning implementations; resolve native topology/geometry constraints and any genuine lost workflow explicitly.

stages.title: Close all Grid families
stages.scope: Join all 89 Grid surface entries, 17 dynamic groups, 30 contracts and 41 original acceptance IDs with current evidence and approved dispositions.
stages.acceptance: All G01-G20 inherited/default/callback/branch obligations resolve before family closure; no new renderer/cache/event/selection engine or generic remaining-Grid milestone.

stages.title: Close core semantic coverage
stages.scope: Resolve all 260 core surface entries and 15 dynamic groups, including inherited AjaxSettings, externally invoked inspection, aliases, native helper outcomes and callback/config branches.
stages.acceptance: Every C01-C15 family has current implementation/witness evidence or an exact approved omission; no pending candidate, TODO-only promise or static-reference shortcut can close it.

stages.title: Close UI semantic coverage
stages.scope: Resolve all 426 non-Grid UI entries, 21 dynamic groups, 750 supplemental records and five audit findings against completed owning stages.
stages.acceptance: All U01-U25 and secondary Grid/core owners close; duplicate declarations, inherited shapes/defaults, context, callbacks and actual legacy workflow cases retain individual resolutions.

stages.title: Final P0 and cross-owner reconciliation
stages.scope: Reconcile the entire 60-family/775-entry/53-dynamic inventory and supplemental/external paths, all omission decisions and helper deletion proofs.
stages.acceptance: Every pending outcome is implemented or specifically approved; new discoveries are assigned back to existing stages, never hidden in a new numbered tail. Freeze an exhaustive current closure report.

stages.title: Compact API, docs, migration and demos
stages.scope: Finalize short source-linked contracts, complete legacy workflow migration, working demos/options/failures and consistent errors/exports/types; prune proven unnecessary API/docs/files.
stages.acceptance: An agent can locate one owner and execute examples without contradictory copies or unused extension engines. Every removed helper has reachability proof; every lost supported capability has the consolidated decision.

stages.title: Integrated browser, accessibility, load and package gates
stages.scope: Run complete source and exact installed-artifact checks; keyboard/focus/labels/ARIA/MDI/two-layout and complete-page accessibility review; available Windows assistive technology, OS IME and clipboard flows. Retain original performance fixtures/budgets.
stages.acceptance: Build/types/examples/units, three source engines and five installed browsers, 9+21 budgets, raw medians/geometry/cleanup, package/license/export checks and changed/full docs pass. Record actual manual tools/results; real Safari alone stays excluded.
stages.condition: An unavailable manual/hardware result is an explicit unresolved claim or user-reviewed limit, never an automated pass.

stages.title: Fixed coding-agent task acceptance
stages.scope: Replay screen addition, field/validation/save modification and delayed-response/listener-disposal repair on pinned seeds, briefs, model/context/tool conditions and one declared read meter.
stages.acceptance: Correctness first, then retries/search/read/changed-scope/time and available actual tokens. Bytes/files are separate proxies. Investigate poor navigation/generated-code consistency; repeat affected tasks after corrections.
stages.condition: This plan runs no model/response evaluation; future coding-task measurements follow their explicit authorized evaluation contract.

stages.title: Freeze and review the whole repository
stages.scope: Freeze source, load assumptions and artifact after parity. Invoke ponytail:ponytail-review explicitly on all 2.0 runtime, connected callers, tests/tools/examples, package and docs, including code outside the last diff.
stages.acceptance: Preserve a read-only numbered report with concrete reproduction, wrong result, smallest correction and consequence for each correctness/security/data-loss/load/testing/speed/lean finding.

stages.title: Resolve review findings
stages.scope: Fix every confirmed Must fix and Should fix through the owning shared cause and callers; retain failing-baseline regression or deterministic equivalent. Decide every Nice to have explicitly.
stages.acceptance: No confirmed blocking finding is deferred; smallest complete corrections include tests/fixtures/types/docs and affected performance/binding/lifecycle checks. Repeat inside this step instead of adding milestones.

stages.title: Independent whole-scope re-review
stages.scope: Independently verify every original/new finding, correction, connected flow, regression and declared suggestion disposition.
stages.acceptance: No unresolved Must fix/Should fix remains; disproofs have evidence. Reopen M13.2 for failures, keeping fixed step IDs and the exhaustive review scope.

stages.title: Final frozen unpublished handoff
stages.scope: Run final full source/installed-artifact/browser/performance/docs gates on corrected frozen source; replay all three fixed coding-agent tasks under the same method. Preserve archive/log/source identities and independent evidence review.
stages.acceptance: All required parity and review gates agree with actual package/API/docs. Produce an unpublished feature-test package, full feature matrix and known limits for personal testing.

stages.title: Personal feature acceptance
stages.scope: Hand the complete unpublished result and numbered feature/demo checklist to the user for one-by-one tests. Record exact artifact, browser, steps and feedback.
stages.acceptance: User-provided acceptance/defect results exist; automation or silence cannot substitute for personal approval.
stages.condition: User action; publication and release tags remain deferred.

stages.title: Personal findings and re-acceptance
stages.scope: Fix reported defects under their existing owner, add regressions and independent re-review, refresh affected package/runtime/docs gates and return the exact updated result to the user.
stages.acceptance: User confirms the corrected feature set; material contract changes reopen the affected review and fixed tasks. Repeat within this step until accepted.
stages.condition: User confirmation is required; no automatic acceptance.

stages.title: Requested release readiness
stages.scope: After personal acceptance and a new release request, finalize support/Node-tool promise, license/registry permissions, manifest/entries, release notes/migration and exact beta artifact.
stages.acceptance: Read-only registry checks and actual isolated JS/TS/five-browser/package/performance/docs gates match the final versioned artifact; prepare a concrete reviewable result.
stages.condition: A later explicit release request activates release work; this plan does not authorize registry writes or tags.

stages.title: Beta and release-candidate validation
stages.scope: Verify beta then rc.N candidates and resolve findings; each manifest/version change creates a fresh exact archive and artifact-dependent checks.
stages.acceptance: Candidates have no blockers; preserve all evidence and reviewed limitations. Publish prereleases/tags only for the exact artifact and action explicitly authorized at that time.
stages.condition: Unpublished validation may proceed within the release request; every registry/tag action requires its explicit artifact approval.

stages.title: Stable 2.0.0 artifact and publication
stages.scope: Prepare the final stable manifest/archive, fresh artifact gates, release notes and concrete npm/tag actions. After explicit approval, publish once and verify registry checksum/install/tag source.
stages.acceptance: The stable package, source, declarations, docs and tag agree. Stop before an unauthorized write; a released version is never overwritten.
stages.condition: Separate explicit stable-artifact publication/tag approval; no permission is inferred from this planning task.

stages.title: Requested master/archive transition and final cleanup
stages.scope: Prepare a separate branch/archive proposal after the accepted stable result. Capture and verify the old master in a named archive before promoting 2.0; remove active v1/worktrees only when separately authorized and safely preserved.
stages.acceptance: Remote archive and promoted source match reviewed commits, documentation links retain immutable v1/LGPL provenance, saved work is verified before removal and the worktree is clean. No automatic force-push/history rewrite.
stages.condition: Separate explicit branch/archive/removal approval. Until then keep alpha branch, master, v1 and their licenses unchanged. This optional repository transition does not block an otherwise authorized package release.
